method: Direct visual inspection of rendered contact sheets; targeted full preview inspection for the defective wine glass and classroom background.

quarantine.reason: Visible black/pink stippled rendering defect across the glass. Keep legacy file and identity; exclude new selection until repaired and re-reviewed.

rotationVariantCaveat: Visual rotation derivatives, not claims of byte-identical or pixel-identical duplicate files.

repair.reason: Opaque full-canvas backdrop interferes with compositing. Remove only exact repository-authored backdrop; retain illustrated shapes and IDs.
Correlated particle positions create repeated diagonal bands. Replace with deterministic stratified scatter.
White/transparent objects lose contrast on pale previews. Use neutral checkerboard, accurate PBR/low-poly labels and on-demand small thumbnails.

alreadyExcludedBeforeThisReview.finding: Oval placeholder meshes, not usable fitted clothing. Existing runtime already excludes these legacy GLBs; do not count them as newly removed.
Blockout-only backgrounds already retired from new selection in PR 770; preserve legacy ID lookup.

retainedWithContext: Purposeful low-poly modular roads, ground pieces, buildings and plants are retained as low-poly, not mislabeled high-detail art.
Arcade rear view and environment roof occlusion are preview-camera limitations, not evidence that the actual source mesh is defective.
Existing VRM thumbnails were inspected, but thumbnail review does not establish fitted clothing or pose quality.
The classroom background includes Japanese signage. It is coherent art; locale-specific signage is not a reason to delete it as corrupted.
